description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of categories across which Large Language Models are evaluated, as presented in the paper "Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models". The chart is divided into ten distinct slices, each labeled with a category name and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored blue, represents "AI/NLP Research" at 24.3%. The second largest, colored teal, is "Econ. & Fin." at 18.4%. Other significant segments include "History" (8.2%, yellow), "Game&Anime" (8.2%, orange), "Med & Health" (6.7%, green), and "Science" (6.7%, light blue). Smaller segments are "Daily Life" (7.1%, light blue-green), "Pet & Animal" (5.5%, orange), "Law" (5.1%, red), "Business" (5.9%, red), "Geography" (2.7%, yellow), and "Math" (1.2%, green). Each category is clearly labeled with its percentage value outside the pie, and the chart does not include a legend or exploded slices; the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size from the top right.
